svg.text: Row wiring options on the board, fewest pins first
Thick line = a row node chained through its keys. Thin line = bus to its array column. Red ring + dashed line = deviant key sent to the spare node. Colors are nodes.
4 deviant keys, 2 rows split mid-row · array 7 columns · 5 crossings
A: 7 pins, hop over the deviants
chains whole; 4 stubs to the spare node · array 7 columns · 3 crossings
3 deviants, 1 row split mid-row · array 7 columns · 5 crossings
2 end deviants, no split row · array 7 columns · 0 crossings
1 end deviant, no split row · array 7 columns · 0 crossings
regular matrix: no deviants, no array
